## Contribution Checklist

Please confirm your submission meets the following criteria:

### Quality requirements (for open-source projects)
- [ ] Has at least 100 GitHub stars
- [ ] Is at least 2 months old
- [ ] Has a commit within the last 12 months
- [ ] Is not archived on GitHub
- [ ] Is a developer resource (library, tool, or learning resource), not an end-user app

### Commercial disclosure (if applicable)
- [ ] If commercial: has an open-source SDK with 100+ stars
- [ ] If commercial: offers a free tier for developers
- [ ] If commercial: will be placed at the end of the section and marked as commercial

### Content requirements
- [ ] Has a neutral, descriptive summary (no hype words or star counts)
- [ ] Uses the format: `- [Name](link) - Description.` (ending with a period)
- [ ] Link has been tested and works
- [ ] Added to the appropriate section in alphabetical order (where applicable)
- [ ] No spelling or grammar errors

### Due diligence
- [ ] Searched for duplicates—this is not already listed
- [ ] Making one entry per PR (preferred)

### Affiliation
- [ ] I am affiliated with this project (author, maintainer, or contributor)
- [ ] I am not affiliated with this project
